title: Ask The Urban Farmer -- Certified Organic?
summary: Urban farmer answers whether small market farms need organic certification, saying it depends on the market: direct customers who know the farmer need it less, while the seal matters for anonymous grocery purchases.

assertions.quote: they're not certified organic but I know them and I know the way they Farm
if you know and trust your farmer then a stamp on a piece of paper doesn't really mean much

verdicts.note: Whether personal trust substitutes for third-party verification is a judgment about the buyer's values and knowledge.

assertions.quote: it has that stamp of approval then I think it offers value

verdicts.note: This is shopping advice about when third-party verification adds value.
